method: built-in image_gen.imagegen; three calls including one targeted enchant revision
enchant_v1_review: Retained as source and runtime-sizes.png evidence; too thin at 30 px beside Combat/Mounted.
enchant_v2_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Standalone transparent fantasy-game condition icon for Weapon enchant, designed primarily for only 30x30 pixels. Make a COMPACT, BROAD short enchanted broadsword: very wide leaf-shaped blackened-steel blade, stout bronze guard and short chestnut leather grip, angled diagonally lower-left to upper-right. The blade must be substantially wide and short, occupying much more area than a thin long sword; compact broad silhouette with similar visual mass to a horse-head emblem or crossed swords. Pale warm-ivory highlights and a clearly visible, restrained desaturated sage-blue coating along one broad blade face communicate temporary weapon oil/enchantment. No bright glow. Hand-painted fantasy-game realism; simplified chunky shapes, shallow dimensionality, soft upper-left light, aged bronze, dark steel and walnut/chestnut tones. Comfortable actual transparent padding evenly around the object, centered square canvas, object fills about 80% of canvas. No text, symbols, runes, labels, border, inventory-icon square background, tile, circular badge, scenery, extra weapon, neon, particles, sparkles, shadow or glow outside the object. Readable at tiny UI size. This must be one broad compact enchanted weapon, distinct from the nonmagical crossed-swords Combat icon.

prompts.enchant: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone transparent fantasy-game condition-type icon, for a 30px palette and 45px condition card. Subject: one stout blackened-steel sword angled from lower-left hilt to upper-right tip, with a worn aged-bronze guard and chestnut-leather grip. A restrained desaturated sage-blue enchantment follows only a small section of the blade, communicating a temporary weapon enhancement or applied weapon oil. Strong simple single-weapon silhouette; chunky readable shapes; restrained hand-painted realism, softly lit from upper left, shallow dimensionality, coordinated with TwichUI painted ivory-maned brown horse and aged-bronze icons. Warm ivory blade highlights, muted bronze and chestnut, very small magical accent. Centered on square canvas, comfortable even transparent padding, apparent object fills about 80% of canvas. Actual transparent background. No text, labels, numbers, runes, inventory tile, square backdrop, border, badge, scene, shadow outside object, glow cloud, sparkles, neon, ornament or extra weapons. No crossed swords: this is weapon enchant, not combat.
prompts.combat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone transparent fantasy-game Combat condition icon. A pair of stout crossed swords forming a compact symmetrical X, tips upward and hilts downward. Blackened dark-steel blades with restrained warm ivory edge highlights, worn aged-bronze guards and chestnut leather grips. No magic or enchantment; these weapons communicate combat, distinct from a single magically enhanced blade. Hand-painted realism, simplified chunky shapes with strong silhouette, soft upper-left lighting, shallow dimensionality, matching TwichUI's restrained aged-bronze and brown-leather artwork and ivory-maned horse emblem. Approximately equal optical weight to other small UI condition icons; readable at 30px palette and 45px card size. Centered square canvas with comfortable equal transparent padding, motif about 80% of canvas. Actual transparent background. No square inventory tile, badge, shield, border, text, labels, numbers, runes, scenery, glow, particles, neon, excessive ornament, or shadow beyond the object.
